fields.title: Shopify Store Analyzer record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope on top of Shopify's own public JSON shapes. Every record carries _input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType (and _error / _errorDetail on failures). Shopify's field names are preserved verbatim -- a PRODUCT row is a Shopify product object with its variants, images and options nested as-is. Use recordType to split a run's mixed output into tables.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact store URL you supplied that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-store-profile, S1-products-json, S1-collections-json, S1-snapshot-diff, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: STORE, PRODUCT, NEW_PRODUCT, VARIANT, COLLECTION, CHANGE, CHANGE_SUMMARY, SNAPSHOT_BASELINE, or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows: bad_input, domain_unreachable, not_shopify, no_public_catalogue, empty_catalogue, no_new_products, no_collections, html_instead_of_json, timeout, retries_exhausted, or exception.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal marker. first_run_no_baseline on a SNAPSHOT_BASELINE row means there was nothing to compare against yet.

_notes.title: Resolution notes
_notes.description: STORE rows -- how the store was resolved, e.g. a redirect to a regional storefront or a catalogue served from the myshopify.com domain.

requestedDomain.title: Requested domain
requestedDomain.description: STORE rows -- the domain you asked for.

resolvedDomain.title: Resolved domain
resolvedDomain.description: STORE rows -- the domain that actually answered. Differs from requested when a store redirects by region.

catalogueDomain.title: Catalogue domain
catalogueDomain.description: STORE rows -- the domain the product data came from.

myshopifyDomain.title: Shopify domain
myshopifyDomain.description: STORE rows -- the store's permanent .myshopify.com address.

isShopify.title: Is Shopify
isShopify.description: STORE rows -- whether the site is a Shopify store.

detectionConfidence.title: Detection confidence
detectionConfidence.description: STORE rows -- confirmed (the site identifies itself as Shopify) or likely (only indirect signs).

storefrontType.title: Storefront type
storefrontType.description: STORE rows -- liquid-theme for a standard Shopify theme, headless for a custom front end.

isHeadless.title: Is headless
isHeadless.description: STORE rows -- true when the shop front end is custom-built rather than a Shopify theme.

poweredBy.title: Platform stack
poweredBy.description: STORE rows -- the platform the site reports, e.g. 'Shopify' or 'Shopify, Oxygen, Hydrogen'.

themeName.title: Theme
themeName.description: STORE rows -- the theme the store runs, e.g. Dawn, Split, Horizon. Empty on headless stores, which have no theme.

themeLabel.title: Theme label
themeLabel.description: STORE rows -- the merchant's own name for their theme version, often a release note.

themeId.title: Theme ID
themeId.description: STORE rows -- the live theme's numeric id.

themeStoreId.title: Theme Store ID
themeStoreId.description: STORE rows -- set when the theme comes from the official Shopify Theme Store.

themeSchemaVersion.title: Theme version
themeSchemaVersion.description: STORE rows -- the theme's version number.

isThemeStoreTheme.title: Official theme
isThemeStoreTheme.description: STORE rows -- true for an official Theme Store theme, false for a custom or heavily modified one.

shop_name.title: Shop name
shop_name.description: STORE rows -- the store's own name.

shop_currency.title: Currency
shop_currency.description: STORE rows -- the store's currency code.

shop_country.title: Country
shop_country.description: STORE rows -- the store's registered country.

shop_published_products_count.title: Products (reported)
shop_published_products_count.description: STORE rows -- how many products the store says it publishes.

productsScraped.title: Products scraped
productsScraped.description: STORE rows -- how many products this run actually read.

variantCount.title: Variants
variantCount.description: STORE rows -- total variants across scraped products. PRODUCT rows -- variants on that product.

avgPrice.title: Average price
avgPrice.description: STORE rows -- mean of each product's lowest variant price.

productsOnSale.title: Products on sale
productsOnSale.description: STORE rows -- how many products have a variant discounted below its compare-at price.

productsInStock.title: Products in stock
productsInStock.description: STORE rows -- how many products have at least one available variant.

newestPublishedAt.title: Newest product date
newestPublishedAt.description: STORE rows -- when the most recent product went live.

title.title: Title
title.description: Product, collection or change rows -- the item name.

handle.title: Handle
handle.description: The URL slug Shopify uses for this product or collection.

productUrl.title: Product URL
productUrl.description: Added by this actor -- the shoppable link to the product page.

storeDomain.title: Store domain
storeDomain.description: Which store this row belongs to, for multi-store runs.

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.description: PRODUCT rows -- the brand or supplier Shopify records.

product_type.title: Product type
product_type.description: PRODUCT rows -- the store's own product category.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: PRODUCT rows -- merchandising tags, often revealing collections and campaigns.

published_at.title: Published at
published_at.description: PRODUCT rows -- when the product went live in the store. This is what 'newly added' is based on.

created_at.title: Created at
created_at.description: PRODUCT rows -- when the product record was first created, which can be much earlier than its publish date.

updated_at.title: Updated at
updated_at.description: PRODUCT rows -- when the product was last edited.

body_html.title: Description
body_html.description: PRODUCT rows -- the product description as HTML.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: PRODUCT rows -- every variant with price, compare_at_price, sku, availability, options and weight.

options.title: Options
options.description: PRODUCT rows -- the option axes (Size, Colour...) and their possible values.

images.title: Images
images.description: PRODUCT rows -- product images with source URL and dimensions.

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: PRODUCT rows -- cheapest variant price, as a number ready for sorting.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: PRODUCT rows -- dearest variant price, as a number.

maxCompareAtPrice.title: Compare-at price
maxCompareAtPrice.description: PRODUCT rows -- highest compare-at (was) price across variants.

onSale.title: On sale
onSale.description: PRODUCT rows -- true when a variant is priced below its compare-at price.

inStock.title: In stock
inStock.description: PRODUCT rows -- true when at least one variant is available.

availableVariantCount.title: Available variants
availableVariantCount.description: PRODUCT rows -- how many variants are currently purchasable.

price.title: Price
price.description: VARIANT rows -- Shopify's price string for this variant.

priceValue.title: Price (number)
priceValue.description: VARIANT rows -- the same price as a number, ready for sorting and charts.

sku.title: SKU
sku.description: VARIANT rows -- the merchant's stock code.

available.title: Available
available.description: VARIANT rows -- whether this exact variant can be bought right now.

products_count.title: Products in collection
products_count.description: COLLECTION rows -- how many products the collection holds.

collectionUrl.title: Collection URL
collectionUrl.description: COLLECTION rows -- added by this actor, the link to the collection page.

changeType.title: Change type
changeType.description: CHANGE rows -- NEW, REMOVED, PRICE_CHANGED, BACK_IN_STOCK or OUT_OF_STOCK.

priceBefore.title: Price before
priceBefore.description: CHANGE rows -- the price at the previous run.

priceDelta.title: Price change
priceDelta.description: CHANGE rows -- how much the price moved; negative means a price cut.

changesDetected.title: Changes detected
changesDetected.description: CHANGE_SUMMARY rows -- how many changes this run found.

previousCapturedAt.title: Previous run at
previousCapturedAt.description: CHANGE_SUMMARY rows -- when the baseline being compared against was captured.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across every record type this actor emits.

stores.title: Stores
stores.description: One row per store: identity, theme and catalogue stats.

products.title: Products
products.description: Catalogue rows with pricing and stock.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: What changed since the previous run.
